_note: Prakriti classification primarily from Vimana sthana and Sharira sthana. Data here extracted from Chikitsasthana Ch.XX-XXIV (treatment context). Full prakriti engine requires data from those dedicated chapters.

digestive: Retention of flatus, urine and stool tendency
disease_tendency: Vatika poisoning effects — cardiac pain, upward movement of vayu, stiffness, dilataion of blood vessels, pain in bone joints, giddiness, twisting and blackishness in body
Uccitinga and scorpion poison predominant in vata
aggravated_signs: Feeling as if ants crawling on body

disease_tendency: Paittika poisoning — loss of consciousness, hot expiration, heart-burning, pungent taste in mouth, tearing of flesh, swelling red or yellow
Pitta — agent of absorption of body fluid causing trsna
aggravated_signs: Green and yellow coloration in eyes, urine and stool
Raised eruptions with intense burning and tearing pain, suppurating quickly

disease_tendency: Kaphaja trsna — stiffness, anorexia, indigestion, lassitude, vomiting
Kaphaja poisoning — vomiting, anorexia, nausea, salivation, excitement, heaviness, cold and sweetness of mouth
Insects, hornets etc. predominant in kapha
aggravated_signs: Whiteness in nails, eyes, face, skin, urine and stool

vata_pitta: Agneya visarpa symptoms — burning in body, vomiting, diarrhoea, fainting
Both agents of absorption of body fluid — strong trsna tendency
pitta_kapha: Kardama visarpa — cold fever, heaviness, burning, wetness, consciousness loss
Putrified flesh, cadaverous smell (both pitta heat and kapha moisture)
vata_kapha: Granthi visarpa — chain of glands, obstructed vayu, slowly suppurating glands

sama_prakriti: Sannipataja visarpa — all three doshas vitiated equally, all symptoms present, incurable
Sannipataja trsna — continuous, fatal, with severe complications
Sannipataja conditions generally incurable or difficult to manage
